answer: Sybil farms spin many lookalike agents to vote as one bloc. An applicant must bind to one graph vertex and lock a walnut bond of 42.5 POA for 16 hours before votes count. A liveness pulse is signed every 8 minutes along a 4-hop path with no reuse of the last two hops. Peers recompute the path digest and drop any pulse with hop reuse or clock skew over 20 seconds. After three missed pulses, or two vertices pulse within 12 seconds on one schedule, 65% of the walnut is slashed and that vertex is quarantined 30 hours; remainder unlocks after a clean 16-hour window.
